world_builder.changelog: Require exact declared character/location subjects for initial claims, keep global world rules out of entity-scoped claims, and preserve the configured story language in all player-facing seed content.

planner.changelog: Use bounded public character profiles as stable planning context and preserve the configured story language in writer-facing prose.

simulator.changelog: Use owner-scoped private NPC canon internally without disclosing it to the player or prose roles, while preserving the configured story language in descriptive output.

context_validator.changelog: Validate public characterization and prevent owner-scoped private NPC canon from leaking through simulation, while preserving the configured story language in diagnostics.

writer.changelog: Render relevant backgrounds through consistent behavior and voice without exposition dumps, while preserving the configured story language in narrative and suggested actions.

critic.changelog: Check narrative characterization against relevant public profiles without requiring exposition, and keep critique feedback in the configured story language.
